title: Canadian Gratin
description: A creamy, cheesy dish made with Canadian bacon and a crunchy topping.
instructions: Cook Canadian bacon in a skillet over medium heat until browned.
In a separate saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add flour and whisk to form a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in heavy cream, whisking continuously.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Stir in shredded cheese until melted.
Add cooked Canadian bacon, salt, and pepper to the cheese sauce.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish.
Top with additional grated cheese and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Garnish with minced aromatic and serve hot.
